summary: Epic 4 wrap-up correction cycle landed the named mechanical control for incident key figure-provenance-command-on-next-line (3 occurrences: Epic 2, 3, 4 wrap-ups): workflow-instruction.md 6 step 3's per-cycle gate block now runs 'python3 scripts/denominator_gate.py --check-provenance' directly under the existing --check line, with an explicit note that it is a DIFFERENT flag, that nonzero exit blocks the push, and that the gate checks a command is present/resolvable but NOT that it runs (so the author must execute each figure command). actual: 2 of the 3 commands ERRORED when actually executed: the work-inventory row used a nonexistent unit field ('state' -> KeyError; units carry 'status'/'wiring_class', and DONE is an atlas bucket, not a unit field) and the population row's regex omitted the 'V ' in '4,334 + V 392' (-> AttributeError on None.group). denominator_gate.py --check-provenance verifies a command is PRESENT and its script path RESOLVABLE, never that it RUNS -- so a green figure-provenance stage can sit on top of broken commands. Rows corrected and re-executed; the invented work-inventory DONE row was dropped rather than guessed at.
